fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-08-25 (evening, 18:15): A silver-coloured smartphone was allegedly snatched from the hand of the complainant at Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex by a person who left quickly. The complainant, Arjun Pandian, provided the contact number 9000000330. Madhan Murugan (9000000216) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Sanjay Shankar may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000332. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly approached from behind and took the phone before leaving the spot.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, suspect, shopping complex, witness, evening, mobile number, phone records
